reach.name: The Reach Riverside
rows: The venue wasn’t reaching its target footfall and needed a refreshed brand identity to reach its new audience.

We restructured the website around the atmosphere of the restaurant and the river, taking a specific cultural lens to ground The Reach Riverside in its mission and target audience. We also remade the logo and applied a new colour palette to the brand, both of which are readily visible on the website.
We are currently building The Reach Riverside into a statement restaurant by Hammersmith Bridge, and the new website is attracting a wider, younger audience.

mand.name: Mandaloun Westfield
rows: Mandaloun Westfield is a restaurant with a longstanding reputation for its food, but in recent years its brand identity lagged behind other brands. We were tasked with bringing it back to life.

This project needed less of a rebrand and more of a refocus. We understood its past success and gave it a younger face, redesigning the website to give both loyal and new customers a new reason to dine.
This project is still underway, but early success is visible in a wider reach and greater awareness of the brand.
